title: Chapter 330 Coming Back For Revenge
content:
Chapter 330 Coming Back For Revenge

Fairyland.

As everyone's eyes lit up.

When they woke up again, they had already returned to the fairy world.

"It seems that the war is over."

Jin Shiyuan sighed a little.

Everyone smiled bitterly, but never expected that this would be the result.

I can only say that the result was so good that they couldn't believe it.

At this time, Lu Daosheng's figure appeared in front of them.

"Master Lord."

Everyone in Huangcheng looked at Lu Daosheng one after another, waiting for Lu Daosheng's next instructions.

The people in the fairy world looked at Lu Daosheng with a complicated expression.

"Senior, we represent the fairy world, thank you for your help."

An Lingyun, the president of Tiandi Academy, took the lead and bowed respectfully to Lu Daosheng.

When the rest of the people saw this, they followed them one after another.

In response, Lu Daosheng raised his hand and an irresistible force lifted everyone up.

"There is no need to thank me. If you want to thank me, just thank my daughter."

As he said that, Lu Daosheng looked at Lu Xue with a smile.

After 300,000 years of separation, Lu Xue is now very different from that in the past.

If it were once, Lu Xue would probably have pounced towards him at this moment, but now, Lu Xue is just standing in the distance and looking at him silently.

At this moment, Lu Daosheng felt helpless.

At this time, everyone bowed to Lu Xue again.

"Leader, you are the savior of the fairy world!"

Hearing this, Lu Xue also smiled.

"The fairy world is not only your fairy world, but also my fairy world, and everyone's fairy world."

Hearing this, everyone in the fairy world smiled.

But in the distance, Lu Daosheng frowned slightly.

"Xiaoxue, aren't you going back to the deserted city?"

At this time, Lu Daosheng suddenly asked Lu Xue.

Suddenly, everyone quickly closed their mouths.

When Lu Xue heard his father’s question, she turned around and looked blankly, saying, “Sorry, Dad, I want to stay in the fairy world.”

Lu Xue's answer made Lu Daosheng feel a little unbelievable.

My daughter doesn't even go back to her home now.

It's over. It's not that it's free from stocking for too long, something goes wrong.

In an instant, Lu Daosheng thought a lot in his mind.

At this time, Lu Xue suddenly laughed.

"Haha, Dad, I'm having fun with you."

Lu Daosheng:...

"You girl, I want to scare your father to death, right?"

Lu Daosheng glared at Lu Xue and said angrily.

Lu Xue snorted and said, "Who told you to ignore me for so long?"

"but,,"

Lu Xue changed her tone and said seriously: "I still have to stay in the fairy world for a while."

"The power of the Wutuo tribe almost destroyed the fairy world. Now, the Wutuo tribe has fallen, but if I leave, who can guarantee whether there will be the next Bird Tuo tribe and the Dog Tuo tribe?"

Hearing Lu Xue's words, everyone in the fairy world was already moved and their eyes were wet.

Unexpectedly, the leader was still thinking about them at this time.

At this moment, Lu Xue was equivalent to a rich man's daughter being thrown into a small company to suffer hardships. Later, the rich man came back to pick her up, but she chose to stay. More importantly, she would lead the entire company to make a fortune together.

This makes them not touched.

"You really decided?"

Lu Daosheng looked at Lu Xue at this moment and felt mixed feelings.

Lu Xue nodded.

And at this time, the void trembled.

The next moment, Yan Lingyun's figure appeared beside Lu Daosheng.

"Xiaoxue, mom is proud of you."

Yan Lingyun looked at Lu Xue in front of her, and the tenderness in her eyes was almost overflowing.

When Lu Xue saw her own mother, her eyes gradually became wet.

"Mom, don't worry, I will go find you soon."

"Okay, mom believes in you."

In this way, Lu Xue and Ao Qing stayed in the fairy world.

Lu Daosheng slowly left with Yan Lingyun and the people in Huangcheng.

Just as Lu Daosheng's figure was about to disappear, Lu Xue suddenly caught up.

"Dad!"

Hearing the movement behind him, Lu Daosheng turned around in surprise.

"Xiaoxue, dad knows that you can't bear to leave me."

"Uh, no, Dad, don't you give me any good things before you leave?"

Lu Xue rubbed her hands and said with a smile.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng's mouth twitched slightly.

well.

Lu Daosheng sighed and then handed Lu Xue a ring.

Looking at the fairy world behind him for a long time, Lu Daosheng suddenly stretched out his palms.

The next moment, an illusory force surged into the fairy world madly.

With the supreme power, we will bless the entire fairy world and benefit all living beings.

Since then, everyone in the fairy world has luck as good as a dragon!

Feeling that even the fairy energy became much stronger, the powerful people in the fairy world immediately knelt down in the direction of Lu Daosheng.

"Thank you for your blessings!"

"Give me a gift to senior!"

......

"Lingyun, guess where we are going?"

As he walked, Lu Daosheng suddenly smiled.

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun lowered her head slightly.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng felt very uncomfortable.

"Lingyun, I know you have suffered a lot of injustice there."

"But this time, I want to make the entire other side of the starry sky crawl at your feet."

After endless years, Lu Daosheng finally returned here with Yan Lingyun.

On the other side of the starry sky!

"Actually, I don't care anymore."

"Um?"

Lu Daosheng looked at Yan Lingyun.

Yan Lingyun smiled sweetly, "If I hadn't suffered so much injustice on the other side of the starry sky, I wouldn't have met you, wouldn't I?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was slightly stunned.

"Hiss, that's it, but don't you hate them?"

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun still smiled, "The revenge that should be restored will still be restored."

"That's true."

Soon, a hazy sea of stars appeared in front of me.

The two completely stepped on the other side of the starry sky.

The entire sea of stars is like endless, endless.

Here, the creature can clearly feel a breath from the origin of matter.

Yan Lingyun took a breath slowly, her eyes full of emotion.

Still such a familiar aura.

And at this moment, the space in front of you suddenly began to tremble.

The next moment, a figure suddenly appeared not far away in front of the two of them.

When Yan Lingyun saw the visitor, she was slightly stunned and her eyebrows were frowned.

Before Yan Lingyun could speak, the man in a dark golden robe in the distance suddenly said excitedly: "Ye Lingzhi, I knew you were still alive!"

At this moment, there was a hint of shock and surprise in the man's eyes.

"Lingyun, is this your friend?"

Lu Daosheng asked on the side.

Yan Lingyun's face was cold, "I am on the other side of the starry sky and have no friends."

Immediately, Yan Lingyun looked at the man in the distance and said indifferently: "Chen Yu, I have nothing to do with you, so when I come back this time, you, including your Chen clan, it is best to do nothing."

What Yan Lingyun is indeed telling the truth.

She had almost no contact with the Chen clan and Chen Yu at the beginning. The only time she had a competition with Chen Yu, that's all.

So, she really has no relationship with Chen Yu.

At least, that's what she thinks.
